item.title: Hayden Panettiere remembered by co-stars and friends after death
item.description: Following her sudden death on Sunday, Hayden Panettiere's co-stars and friends are honoring her friendship, intelligence, and talent.

item.title: Trump threatens Oman, Iran war as 60-day talks window ends
item.description: The 60-day deadline for U.S.-Iran negotiations on a peace deal and reopening the Strait of Hormuz has passed without an agreement.

item.title: Florida voters pick governor, Senate nominees in primaries
item.description: Three states hold primaries Tuesday, with Florida deciding nominees for governor and Senate.

item.title: Florida to carry out 13th execution this year in busiest death chamber
item.description: A Florida man convicted of fatally shooting his estranged wife and wounding his mother-in-law is scheduled for execution.
